about 3h45 with everything prepared (collecting the materials can take days)

{npc:Bozo}, the jester of Thais, accepts you into the Fools Guild and sends you on eleven prank missions around the world: steal the dwarven emperor's beard, put a whoopee cushion on the throne of the queen of Carlin, deliver exploding cookies to ten NPCs and scare the caliph of Darashia dressed as a mummy. In return you receive the {wiki:Jester Outfits|Jester Outfit}, both addons ({item:Jester Staff} and {item:Jester Hat}) and three achievements.
This outfit is ideal for any Tibian who loves clowning around or playing pranks on others.
Level 40 only for the second addon (Jester Hat); level 60+ recommended.
Access to your djinn's fortress (Yaman or Nah'Bob) for mission 10 — you do not need to have finished the Djinn Quest.
{item:Key 3800} (may be needed to open the emperor's bedroom door in Kazordoon).

For mission 10 (cookies): access to Meriana (the *Access to Meriana* mission of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest}) to reach Ariella and access to Nibelor ({npc:Iskan}'s mission in {wiki:The Ice Islands Quest|The Ice Islands Quest}) to reach Hjaern; level 40 to pass the door of the Orc King's room.
one for the flower (mission 1, it breaks) and another for the bush (mission 8). A normal Knife will not do
240 gp for the box of pies
to climb up the holes (Thais Troll Cave, Mintwallin, Venore Rotworm Cave, Orc Fortress)
to open the entrance of the Thais Troll Cave and the Venore Rotworm Cave
{wiki:Jester Outfits|Jester Outfit} (after mission 5 and the four pieces of cloth)
Gather the materials before you start: with everything ready and using lots of {spell:Haste}, the whole quest takes about 3 hours 45 minutes.
All the missions start and end with {npc:Bozo}: say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and answer {key:yes} when he asks whether you have what he asked for.
Keep the {item:Special Flask (Fools Guild)|special flask}: it is used in missions 2 and 9. If you lose it, you can buy another from Bozo by asking for {key:vial}.
You need **two** of your own {item:Kitchen Knife|Kitchen Knives} (flower and bush). You find the third one, for cutting the beard, during the time travel.
Approximate time for each mission, assuming you already have the materials and use {spell:Haste}.
Use this table to plan the quest. Mission 10 (cookies) is by far the most time-consuming, because you have to travel around the world.

In the kitchen of the {wiki:Thais Troll Cave|troll cave} east of Thais (leave through Thais's **east** gate; the entrance is a hole on the **north** side of a small mountain, which you open with a {item:Shovel}; down there take the **left** path, towards the trolls) there is a {item:Crate|crate} with a broken pot on top that holds **two** {item:Kitchen Knife|Kitchen Knives}. On the floor above, where the {creature:Troll} and the {creature:Troll Champion} are, there is another crate with one more. You can also buy them for 10 gp from {npc:Chephan}, in Venore. To leave the cave, go back the same way and climb the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}; Thais is to the **west**.
Go to **Thais** and talk to {npc:Bozo}. Say {key:hi}, {key:join} and answer {key:yes} twice to join the Fools Guild. He gives you the first mission straight away.
Going to the White Flower Temple

Leave through Thais's south gate and keep going **south** until you reach a river. Go around the river and keep heading further south until you see a small building: it is the {wiki:White Flower Temple}.

The right flower is **inside the protected zone** of the temple, in the **north-east corner**, right next to the inner wall on the right-hand side. Use a {item:Kitchen Knife} on that {item:White Flower}. If you pick the wrong flower, *"This flower is too pathetic."* appears; with the right one, *"The stubborn flower has ruined your knife but at least you got it."* appears.
It has to be a {item:Kitchen Knife}, not a regular {item:Knife}. The knife breaks when you cut the flower.
Walk back **north** to Thais, the same way (going around the river), and talk to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo}. He gives you a {item:Special Flask (Fools Guild)|special flask} to collect the smell of a freshly killed {creature:Slime}.

The nearest {creature:Slime} is in the {wiki:Ancient Temple}, just north-west of Thais' north gate: enter the temple and go down to **floor -4** (or go to the {wiki:Thais Troll Cave}). Kill it and **use the flask straight away** on the poison field left on the ground. You get covered by a {wiki:Poison Gas|poison field} and *"This mission stinks ... and now you do as well!"* appears.
You only have a few seconds: if you take too long, the poison field disappears and you have to kill another Slime.
Go back up the same way to the surface of the Ancient Temple and return to {npc:Bozo}, right there in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.
4. Mission 3 – A Piece of Cake (the pies)
Bozo wants a box with 12 pies from Mirabell, in Edron. Mirabell needs 24 {item:Flour} (2 per pie) and charges 240 gp.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo}. He asks you for a dozen pies from {npc:Mirabell}.

If you don't have flour yet: in **Edron**, cut {item:Wheat|wheat} **south** of the city (with a {item:Scythe}) and grind it in the {item:Millstone} of the {wiki:Ivory Towers|Ivory Tower} in the **north-west**. You need 24 {item:Flour}.

Go to {npc:Mirabell}'s tavern in Edron (above the depot). Say {key:hi}, {key:12 pies}, {key:flour}, {key:yes}, then {key:12 pies} and {key:yes} again. You pay 240 gp and receive the {item:Box (Pies)|box of pies}.
Carry the pies on foot to Thais

Walk through the {wiki:Edron Rotworm Cave} to **Cormaya**: the entrances are **south** of Edron (see coordinates) and the cave connects underground to Cormaya. In Cormaya, go down to the {wiki:Steamship} (under the Cormaya garden, 8 floors below ground level) and talk to {npc:Gurbasch}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon} and {key:yes} (160 gp). You arrive at the underground port of Kazordoon; go up to the surface, leave the city and walk to Thais, to the **west**.

You **cannot**: send the box by {item:Parcel} (the {wiki:Parcel Bugs} eat the pies), walk past the {creature:Edron Guardsman|Edron Guardsmen} to the boat (they destroy the box), use {npc:Pino}'s carpet, use the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System} or any teleport scrolls.
Entrance of the Edron Rotworm Cave (south of Edron)
Another entrance of the Edron Rotworm Cave
Another entrance of the Edron Rotworm Cave
Map of the Edron Rotworm Cave (1)
Map of the Edron Rotworm Cave (2)
Map of the Edron Rotworm Cave (3)
Map of the Edron Rotworm Cave (4)
Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes} to {npc:Bozo}. You earn the title *Fool in Training*.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo}: he wants 18 {item:Vial|vials} of wine.
{item:Vial|Vials} can only be obtained by buying liquids: buy them from {npc:Sandra} in Edron (water is the cheapest), from some NPCs that sell oil, or at certain {wiki:Daily Respawns}.

Go to the {wiki:Rain Castle} (the king's castle, in the north-west of Thais, where Bozo is): enter through the front doors, follow the **east** passage to the kitchen, at the back of the castle. Use the empty vials on the {item:Wine Cask} until you have 18 vials of wine.
Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He puts the wine in a {item:Crate (Wine)|crate} just like the ones that deliver the mana potions to Xodet.
Swap the crate at Xodet's door

Go to {npc:Xodet}'s shop, east of the Thais temple. In front of the shop there is a {item:Crate (Xodet)|crate}. **Use** Bozo's crate on that crate. *"Your innocent whistle will fool them all..."* appears along with yellow sparkles, and you receive the {item:Crate (Swapped)|swapped crate}.
Crate in front of Xodet's shop
6. Mission 5 – Watch out for the fool / Time to do something foolish
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo}. He sends you to fetch a magical watch from the {wiki:Triangle Tower}, north of the Jakundaf desert.

Go to the {wiki:Triangle Tower}, east of Thais, south of Kazordoon and north-west of the Desert Dungeon. If the entrance is closed, pull the lever hidden under rubble in the desert, on the other side of the river (see coordinates). Go up **three floors**. Along the way you have to kill {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}.
Lever that opens the tower (under debris)
{creature:Stalker|Stalkers} turn invisible; {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} hit hard for low levels.
On the 3rd floor, behind a {item:Door (Sealed)|quest door}, open the {item:Box|box} and take the {item:Magical Watch}.

Go down the three floors the same way and leave through the entrance. If someone has closed the tower in the meantime, go down to the basement and use the teleport, which takes you outside (careful with the {creature:Bonelord} there). Then go back to Thais, to the **west**.

Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He explains the plan: enter the dwarven emperor's bedroom, use the watch next to the bed's pillow, cut the sleeping emperor's beard and use the watch again.
The watch only works **2 times** (there and back). Don't go back to Bozo without the beard.

Go to **Kazordoon** and climb to {npc:Emperor Kruzak}'s bedroom, **four floors above** ground level, at the {wiki:Emperor's Cookies Quest} location. You may need to use {item:Key 3800} to open the bedroom door.

Stand next to the **head** of the bed (by the pillow) and **use** the {item:Magical Watch}. *"You are travelling in time."* appears and you end up next to the sleeping emperor {wiki:Gramlok Silverbeard|Gramlok Silverbeard}.
Use the watch — don't throw it onto the bed.
Find a knife in the past
If you need a knife: during the time travel there is a {item:Box|box} with a {item:Kitchen Knife} (and a book inside a bag).
Use the {item:Kitchen Knife} on Gramlok's head. You receive {item:The Dwarven Emperor's Beard} and *"This is probably the most foolish thing you've ever done!"* appears.
When you cut the beard, a {creature:Dwarf Guard} appears to attack you.
Use the {item:Magical Watch} again to go back to a time when the room is empty, and leave: go down the four floors the same way to the city of Kazordoon and return to Thais.
Take the beard to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. Now he explains how to get your outfit.

Bring 1 {item:Red Piece of Cloth}, 1 {item:Blue Piece of Cloth}, 1 {item:Green Piece of Cloth} and 1 {item:Yellow Piece of Cloth} to {npc:Bozo}. Say {key:jester outfit} and answer {key:yes} four times (red, blue, green, yellow).
8. Mission 6 – The queen of farts (1st addon)
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo}; he asks for 4 {item:Minotaur Leather}. With them in your backpack, say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Now he asks for {item:Spider Silk}. Say {key:mission} and {key:yes} to hand it over. Bozo sews the {item:Whoopee Cushion}.
Say {key:mission} again: Bozo gives you the {item:Whoopee Cushion} and tells you to put it on Queen Eloise's throne, in Carlin.
Travel to **Carlin** and enter {npc:Queen Eloise}'s castle. **Use** the {item:Whoopee Cushion} on the throne.
You have to **use** the cushion on the throne — **don't put/drag it** onto it.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo}: you have to steal the queen's cat's toy mouse and scare the jeweller Carina, in Venore.
Go back to the queen's castle in **Carlin** and go down the stairs to the cat's room. Use the cat's basket: the {item:Toy Mouse} appears **on top of the basket** — pick it up.
The queen's castle (the cat's room is on the floor below)
When you use the basket, the {creature:Kitty} appears and attacks you. It's not worth killing it: grab the mouse and run.
Go up the stairs to leave the cat's room and go to **Venore** (by boat). Look for the jeweller {npc:Carina}, near the bank. Say {key:hi}, {key:mouse} and {key:yes}.
10. Mission 8 – Smoking is a foolish thing
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo}: he wants sulphur from an inactive lava hole.

Go to the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel|tunnel between Thais and Fibula} (the entrance on the mainland side is south-west of Thais), go down the stairs and use the {item:Spoon} on the first {item:Lava Hole (Inactive)|inactive lava hole} you see. You receive {item:Easily Inflammable Sulphur}. To leave, go up the same stairs. Alternative: there is another inactive lava hole at the lone {creature:Fire Devil} spawn in the {wiki:Ancient Temple}.
Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. Now he wants leaves from the Tiquanda bush.
Go to **Port Hope** and head straight **north** from the depot. Look for the {item:Jungle Dweller Bush} and use a {item:Kitchen Knife} on it to get {item:Some Special Leaves}.
The Jungle Dweller Bush north of the Port Hope depot
Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. Then say {key:mission} again and he gives you an exploding {item:Cigar}.
Give the cigar to Theodore Loveless
Travel to **Liberty Bay** and look for {npc:Theodore Loveless}, in the building at the far **north-east**. Say {key:hi}, {key:cigar} and {key:yes}. The cigar blows up in his face.
Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You receive the jester's sceptre — the {item:Jester Staff} addon.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo}. He gives you a {item:Special Flask (Fools Guild)|special flask} to collect {creature:Stalker} blood.
If you lost the flask, ask Bozo for a {key:vial} to buy another one.

Go to the **3rd floor** of the {wiki:Triangle Tower} (if it is closed, use the lever in the desert, as in mission 5), kill a {creature:Stalker} and use the flask on the corpse **immediately** after it dies. Leave as you did last time (through the entrance, or through the basement teleport if the tower closes).
Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He gives you another flask for the quara ink.

Kill a {creature:Quara Constrictor} or {creature:Quara Constrictor Scout} and use the flask on the fresh corpse to get the {item:Quara Ink|ink}. There are quaras in {wiki:Calassa}, {wiki:Frozen Trench}, {wiki:Malada}, in the {wiki:Sunken Quarter} of Yalahar and in the Liberty Bay raids. For low levels, the best options are the lone {creature:Quara Constrictor Scout} in the south-west of the {wiki:Arena Quarter} (Yalahar) or the lone one on the surface of the {wiki:Vandura Quara Caves}. To reach the lone one in Yalahar, go to the gate between the {wiki:Foreigner Quarter} and the Arena and Zoo Quarter and tell the guard {npc:Tony} {key:pass} and the destination; to come back, go through the same gate. The one in the Vandura Quara Caves is on the surface, next to the cave entrance, **south-west** of Liberty Bay (walk there from the city and return the same way).
Lone Quara Constrictor Scout (Arena Quarter, Yalahar)
Vandura Quara Caves entrance (south-west of Liberty Bay)
In the other areas the quaras roam in groups with other dangerous creatures.
Any player can use the flask: a friend can collect the ink for you, **as long as they are on the same mission** of this quest.
Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. Then say {key:mission} again: he gives you the {item:Magical Inkwell} (ink that vanishes) and tells you to order 2000 shields from Sam.
Go to {npc:Sam}'s weapon shop, in Thais. Say {key:hi}, {key:2000 steel shields}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He gives you a {item:Contract}.
Use the {item:Magical Inkwell} on the contract to get the {item:Signed Contract}. Then say {key:contract} and {key:yes} to Sam.

Bozo gives you 10 {item:Exploding Cookie|exploding cookies} to deliver to 10 NPCs. With each one, say {key:hi}, {key:cookie} and {key:yes}. You can do them in any order. If you forget the list, ask Bozo for it.
Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo} and accept with {key:yes}. You receive 10 {item:Exploding Cookie|Exploding Cookies}.
Give a cookie to each of these NPCs ({key:hi}, {key:cookie}, {key:yes}):
You don't need to have done the Djinn Quest to talk to Yaman or Nah'Bob, only to have access to the fortress. Give the cookie to just one of them, depending on your side.
How to get to (and leave) each cookie NPC
For the NPCs located in cities ({npc:Avar Tar}, in Edron) you just need to take a boat. For the others:
From Thais, cross the {wiki:Fibula Tunnel} (entrance south-west of Thais, {coord:32261,32385,7}) or use the teleport on the 2nd floor of the Knightwatch Tower. He is on the **south** coast of Fibula.
Go back through the tunnel to Thais.
In Liberty Bay, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider} (south-east of the depot): {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp). She is in Sabrehaven, Meriana.
Talk to {npc:Sebastian}, south of Sabrehaven: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
Next to the ruins of the {wiki:Dark Cathedral}: from Venore head **south**, past the swamp, and cross the big plains; the ruins are **west** of the Plains of Havoc.
Walk back the same way to Venore.

In {wiki:Mintwallin}, below the {wiki:Ancient Temple} (north-west of Thais' north gate): go down 2 floors, go as far **north** as possible, go down to the {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms}, head east/south, go down the stairs, pass the {item:Poison Field|Poison Fields}, go down again and, to the **east/north**, go down through the hole (2 {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}). Follow the path to the two stairs and go down: the city gate is a few steps **west**. See {wiki:Route:Mintwallin|Route:Mintwallin}.
Go back the same way, using the {item:Rope} on the holes. There is a shortcut out through a hole with 2 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} (it only works for leaving: you can't enter that way).
In Svargrond, talk to {npc:Iskan} (north-east of the city) and ask for {key:passage} to {wiki:Nibelor}. Hjaern is in a cave in the **north** of the island.
Talk to {npc:Nilsor}, west of the Nibelor stone circle, and ask for {key:passage} to go back to Svargrond.

From Venore take the **south-west** exit and follow the road **north-west**; about 3/4 of the way to the Dwarf Bridge, turn off **north** to the entrance of the Venore Rotworm Cave ({coord:32699,32018,7}; open the {item:Loose Stone Pile} with the {item:Shovel}). Inside, go down one more floor, head **north**, go up with the {item:Rope} at the rope spot, continue to the far **north-east** and climb the ladder. On the surface, climb another ladder to her house.
Go back the same way: go down the two ladders, cross the cave and leave through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}; then follow the road **south-east** to Venore.
From Port Hope, walk **north** through the Tiquanda jungle to {wiki:Banuta} ({coord:32807,32542,7}). He is in the temple in the **south-east** of the city, 1 floor above ground level.

At {wiki:Ulderek's Rock} (Orc Fortress, north-west of Venore): enter the fort's underground through the hole, head **east**, go down the stairs and then go **east** and **north**, passing the **level 40** {item:Gate of Expertise}.
Go back the same way and climb up through the hole with the {item:Rope}; run from the orcs he summons.
At {wiki:Mal'ouquah}, in the mountains of the Ankrahmun desert (Kha'zeel): follow the path next to the oasis into the mountains ({coord:33101,32657,7}). The entrance doors are **level 30**.
Go back the same way to Ankrahmun.
At {wiki:Ashta'daramai}, in the mountains **north** of Ankrahmun: go up the ramp ({coord:33120,32578,7}); careful with the {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}. The entrance doors are **level 30**.
Go back down the same ramp to Ankrahmun.
Venore Rotworm Cave entrance (way to Wyda)
Way to Mintwallin (10, with the exit shortcut)
Watch out for King Markwin and the Orc King

King {npc:Markwin} and {npc:The Orc King} summon the guards the first time you say {key:hi} to them (Markwin doesn't summon them if you are an Archpostman). After the cookie, the Orc King also summons 2 {creature:Orc Warlord|Orc Warlords} and 5 {creature:Slime|Slimes}.
Be ready to fight or run right after delivering to the Orc King.
After the cookie, {npc:Wyda} casts {spell:Soulfire} on you: 10 damage per turn for 60 turns (600 HP in total). Go straight to the nearest priest, {npc:Yberius} in Venore, and ask him to cure you.
After the 10 deliveries you earn the achievement **Allow Cookies?**. Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}.

Say {key:mission} to {npc:Bozo}; he asks for 5 {item:White Piece of Cloth|White Pieces of Cloth} (dropped by {creature:Ghost|Ghosts} and {creature:Spectre|Spectres}). With them in your backpack, say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Bale of White Cloth}.
Travel to **Darashia**, in Darama, and walk **west** to the {wiki:Plague Spike}, the mountain range between the Devourer and Drefia.

Go up and head **left**, where 2 {creature:Wyvern|Wyverns} spawn, and keep climbing to the top. Up there, use the {item:Bale of White Cloth} on the altar and you receive a {item:Bale of Yellowed Cloth}. Then go down the mountain the same way and return to Darashia, to the **east**.
Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He gives you a {item:Mummy Disguise}.
**DO NOT use the disguise yet!** Only near Kazzan. If you use it too early, go back to Bozo and he gives you another one for free.

Go to the **Darashia** palace and approach {npc:Kazzan}. Once next to him, use the {item:Mummy Disguise}: you look like a mummy. You have **10 seconds** to say {key:hi} to Kazzan, who screams *"WAAAAAHHH!!!"*.
Disguised as a mummy, scaring Kazzan
Sorcerers and druids can, instead of the disguise, use {spell:Creature Illusion} to turn into a {creature:Mummy}.
Go back to {npc:Bozo}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Jester Hat} and the addon. When you finish the quest you earn the achievements **Perfect Fool** and **Fool at Heart**.
Also known as the Fools Guild Quest or Jester Outfits Quest.
Level 40 is only required for the second addon (Jester Hat).
